scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @pby/server && npm run build -w @pby/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run dev:all
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @pby/server" "npm run dev -w @pby/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
